Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & economic buyer intro — Horizon AI discovery

Hi Elaine —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap:
- Primary use case: low-latency inference for realtime recommendation pipeline (90% of traffic under 128 tokens).
- Success metrics: p95 latency < 120ms, predictable monthly spend, and ability to scale for Q3 spikes.
- Security requirements: SOC 2, VPC/private deployment option, audit logs retention for 12 months.

Open items / next steps:
1) Economic buyer / budget owner — could you confirm who owns budget for inference spend and procurement cadence? We typically loop them for price / commitment discussions.
2) Security questionnaire — happy to share our SOC 2 report and a short security pack. If you have a questionnaire, please send it over.
3) Procurement timeline — any deadlines we should align to for Q3 rollouts?
4) Proposed follow-up: 30-min budget alignment call next week to include procurement and the budget owner.

Attached is a short pricing & model availability pack to give you a sense of commitment vs. unit pricing (file: Redwood_MAAP_pricing.pdf).

If you prefer, I can introduce Rishi (our solutions lead) and Vivek (head of enterprise) on the thread for the budget conversation — let me know who the best person is on your side to include.

Thanks,

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
www.redwood.ai

Marissa —

Appreciate the recap and the pricing packet. That helps a lot. A few notes from our side: 

1) Budget / economic buyer: Finance owns the budget for infra procurement — I will loop in Jason Lee (cc'd), our procurement lead, who manages contracting and budget approvals. The ultimate sponsor is our VP of Data Platforms (external, not on this thread yet).

2) Security: we do have a standard security questionnaire. I attached our horizon-side questionnaire for you to review — it's focused on data residency, SOC 2, and access controls (file: Horizon_Security_Questionnaire.pdf). Can you confirm you can provide SOC 2 Type II and a diagram of your VPC deployment model? Also we typically require a 12-month log retention and support for KMS integration.

3) Timeline: we're aiming to finalize vendors by mid-June for a July pilot. Procurement will need a commercial proposal + standard contract redlines ahead of that.

Proposed next step: Let's schedule a 30-min call next week with Jason (procurement) and the budget owner / sponsor if possible. Jason, are you available next Tue/Wed?

Thanks,
Elaine
Director of Product | Horizon AI
elaine.park@horizon-ai.com | (650) 555-0123

Attachment: Horizon_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (docx, 12 pages)

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Elaine. Jason — great to e-meet you.

To keep things moving toward your mid-June decision point, proposal from my side:
